text:
rajiv: Quick sync — Singapore cutover on Tue. Who owns what and blockers?

mina: I have routing-policy PR (infra#4231). Waiting on network + compliance. Plan: merge after net ok -> run staging e2e.

jonas: found NACL dropping HC on new peering. Pushing fix now. assigning myself on MR.

elena: infra: peering needs route-map + NAT. Blocker: cloud-account prod-singapore (INF-778). @kira any update?

kira: provisioning in progress, ETA EOD tomorrow. Will post account ID and draft SOC diagram.

compliance-bot: Reminder: data residency checklist incomplete for ap-southeast-1. Missing SOC diagram, dataflow approval, retention policy.

tao: we'll need BGP MED tune on edge routers to prefer local AZs. I can handle once peering is live.

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2026-05-12 03:00-05:00 UTC (10% traffic).

sasha: SRE: created runbook stub https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/singapore-cutover — please add oncall, throttling knobs, SLOs.

mina: routing snippet in PR:
```
route_policy:
  - match: "^/api/"
    backend: "redwood-singapore-v1"
    headers:
      - name: x-region
        value: "ap-southeast-1"
```

jonas: net review LGTM after my NACL change. Mina, merge after Kira confirms compliance.

mina: will hold merge until Kira confirms, then trigger canary.

rajiv: Owners recap: routing=@mina, network=@jonas/@tao, cloud acct=@kira, peering config=@elena, SRE=@sasha, compliance=@kira->@compliance-team. Milestone: cutover window ts 1902350000. Flag blockers by EOD tomorrow.

kira: will update INF-778 and upload SOC diagram + retention note. :white_check_mark:

sasha: adding monitoring + alerting. small request: add kv-cache hit ratio metric export for region to validate warm cache during canary.

mina: will include that metric in canary queries.

rajiv: thanks — i'll brief PMs and update roadmap doc. :rocket:
